text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no command-execution tool here, so I found the bugs by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5, matching the lending-policy comment and the tests.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the days late. It now multiplies (`days_late * DAILY_FEE`).
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing `Emma`. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my guesses.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` sliced `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It now returns `[-n:]`, or an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it with `int(year)`, which also makes `age()` work.
